stocks.name: Castrol India Limited
stocks.fundamental: Near debt-free lubricants leader — ~43% ROE, ~4.5% dividend yield. Q2 CY26 revenue +25%, PAT +43%, EBITDA +41%, and the interim dividend was raised to ₹6.25. Targeting ~2x market volume growth via rural + premium expansion. Overhang: parent bp is selling its global Castrol business to Stonepeak.

stocks.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd
stocks.fundamental: Zero-debt defence-shipbuilding PSU. FY26 revenue +12%, and Q1 FY27 PAT jumped ~21% with margins expanding; analysts model ~20% earnings CAGR and ~28% ROE. Watch: order book slipped to ~₹20,500cr as flagship warship projects complete — the next leg depends on new large contracts (P75I, LPD) and the Colombo Dockyard / Tuticorin commercial push.
